units.source_text: 因为那时候，尽管我产生了一种不严肃的喜悦，

en.t: Because at that time, although a kind of frivolous joy had arisen in me,

units.source_text: 企图通过欲望或这种欲望的完成，来证实爱的不可能，

en.t: and I tried, through desire or through the fulfillment of that desire, to prove the impossibility of love,

units.source_text: 可是，肉体却背叛了它，肉体扮演了我企图以精神来做的事情。

en.t: yet the body betrayed it, and the body performed what I had tried to do with the spirit.
I had run into a contradiction.

units.source_text: 如果说不怕庸俗的表现，那么我就可以以不会被人爱的确信，

en.t: If I may put it in a vulgar way, then with the certainty that I would never be loved,

units.source_text: 来梦见爱，在最后阶段我把欲望作为爱的替代而安心了。

en.t: I could dream of love, and at the final stage I found peace by taking desire as a substitute for love.

units.source_text: 欲望本身要求我忘却我的存在的条件，

en.t: that desire itself demanded that I forget the conditions of my existence,

units.source_text: 要求我放弃我的爱的惟一难关——即不会被人爱这样一种坚定的信念。

en.t: and demanded that I abandon the one obstacle to my love: the firm conviction that I would never be loved.

units.source_text: 由于我相信欲望这种东西是更加明晰的东西，

en.t: Because I believed that desire was something clearer and more lucid,

units.source_text: 所以我并不认为它有必要梦见自己，哪怕是一星半点。

en.t: I did not think it had any need to dream of itself, not even in the slightest.
